news.headline: uniQure (NASDAQ:QURE) Upgraded by Wall Street Zen to "Hold" Rating
news.summary: Wall Street Zen raised uniQure from Sell to Hold, reversing its early-August downgrade as sentiment on the AMT-130 regulatory path improved. The stock traded near $51 at the time of the note.

news.headline: uniQure N.V. (NASDAQ:QURE) Receives $65.00 Consensus Price Target from Brokerages
news.summary: A roundup of covering analysts put the consensus 12-month price target at $65, with a Moderate/Strong Buy consensus rating, implying meaningful upside from the low-$50s trading range.

news.headline: uniQure (NASDAQ:QURE) Price Target Raised to $75.00 at Wells Fargo & Company
news.summary: Wells Fargo lifted its price target on uniQure to $75 from $60 and kept an Overweight rating following the Q2 print and FDA regulatory clarity on AMT-130.

news.headline: uniQure stock upgraded by Wolfe Research on Huntington's therapy outlook
news.summary: Wolfe Research upgraded uniQure to Outperform from Peer Perform with a $65 price target, citing a 70% probability of AMT-130 approval and about $2 billion in projected peak U.S. sales, arguing the market underprices the accelerated-approval path.

news.headline: uniQure Announces Second Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Provides Company Update
news.summary: uniQure reported Q2 revenue of $5.8M and cash/investments of $810.3M (runway into 2030), confirmed FDA Type B meeting minutes support a Q3 2026 BLA filing for AMT-130, and reiterated that 4-year AMT-130 data are due in September 2026. On the earnings call, CMO Walid Abi-Saab said the company expects and is preparing for a possible FDA Advisory Committee (AdCom) review of the BLA.

news.headline: Senvest Management LLC Buys 22,300 Shares of uniQure N.V. $QURE
news.summary: Senvest Management disclosed a 44.6% increase in its uniQure stake (to 72,300 shares) in a Q1 institutional-holdings filing reported in late July, a modest signal of continued fund accumulation ahead of the September data catalyst.

catalysts.label: AMT-130 4-year topline data
catalysts.detail: Topline 4-year follow-up data from the Phase I/II study (cohorts 1-2, 24 patients, high- and low-dose) expected; will update the 75% cUHDRS slowing seen at 3 years.

catalysts.label: AMT-130 BLA submission to FDA
catalysts.detail: uniQure plans to submit the Biologics License Application under the accelerated approval pathway, using the 3-year Phase I/II data vs. Enroll-HD external control as primary basis; not yet submitted as of 2026-08-27.

catalysts.label: AMT-130 UK MHRA MAA submission
catalysts.detail: Marketing Authorisation Application planned for the UK following a positive MHRA pre-submission meeting; parallel path to the US BLA.

catalysts.label: FDA alignment on confirmatory study design
catalysts.detail: FDA has agreed to work with uniQure to finalize the design of the required post-approval confirmatory study (standard-of-care comparator likely) ahead of/alongside the BLA filing.

catalysts.label: Possible FDA Advisory Committee (AdCom) meeting
catalysts.detail: CMO Walid Abi-Saab said on the Q2 earnings call that an AdCom review of the AMT-130 BLA is likely given it would be the first Huntington's therapy and a novel dataset; company says it welcomes and is preparing for one.

catalysts.label: AMT-260 epilepsy second cohort enrollment complete
catalysts.detail: Enrollment in the second, higher-dose cohort of the Phase I/IIa refractory mesial temporal lobe epilepsy study expected to complete.

catalysts.label: AMT-260/AMT-191 program updates
catalysts.detail: Updated clinical data expected for the epilepsy (AMT-260) and Fabry disease (AMT-191) gene therapy programs.

pulse: QURE shares have held in the high-$40s to low-$50s (~$51 as of 2026-08-27), essentially flat since mid-August, as the market awaits the pivotal AMT-130 4-year Huntington's data readout in September and the Q3 BLA/UK MAA filings. Analyst sentiment has stayed broadly constructive through late July/August (Wolfe Research upgrade to Outperform citing 70% approval odds; Wells Fargo $75 PT; consensus ~$65), even as the CMO flagged a likely FDA Advisory Committee review as an added hurdle before approval. With $810.3M in cash funding operations into 2030, the stock's near-term path now hinges almost entirely on the September data and BLA execution rather than new incremental news.
